correctness.rationale: Complete rational canonical form classification of X; each anticommuting fiber solved exactly and reduced to its invertible centralizer. The split torus acts on off-diagonal pairs by reciprocal weights; the nonsplit torus quotient is classified by the surjective quadratic norm map; nilpotent case reduces to translations. Seven cases partition all X and sum symbolically to 4q²+q−2 for every odd prime power. Independent direct orbit enumeration over F3,F5 yields 37,103.

value.rationale: Gives an entire natural moduli classification of two-dimensional modules of the first nontrivial root-of-unity quantum plane over all odd finite fields, including nonsemisimple classes that GIT omits. Rational split/nonsplit arithmetic and the quadratic field-norm invariant are informative beyond known labeled-point counts or algebraically closed components. This is a complete exact natural invariant, not an arbitrary slice.
